QuestInfo.name: Take the Gold Pouch to Muirhat
QuestInfo.0: I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do.
QuestInfo.1: I should bring the #bGold Pouch#k to #bMuirhat#k as Bartol asked me to. Muirhat is standing #bin front of the Control Room on the upper deck#k.
QuestInfo.2: I've delivered the Gold Pouch to Muirhat.

0.0: First, give this Gold Pouch to Muirhat.

yes.0: This Gold Pouch is from the box that Muirhat asked me to open a week ago, and... I totally forgot about it, hahaha! Muirhat is #bin front of the Navigation Room at the upper hallways of The Nautilus#k. He's always there...
yes.1: Do the three favors I asked you to do, and you'll get the Warp Card. Keep going!

no.0: You don't feel like doing it anymore?

1.0: Ohhh, this is a Gold Pouch with a lot of gold! Did Bartol tell you to give this to me?

yes.0: Ahhh, so this is from the box I asked him to look at a week ago. Tell Bartol I said thanks!

npc.0: Please give Muirhat the Gold Pouch.

item.0: Can I help you with something?

lost.0: You lost it, right? I picked it up right after you left it. Seriously, take care of these things! It's really an expensive item you know. Give this to Muirhat.
